description: Regenerates AI cover image for a drop, with optional text layout. Use when the user wants a new cover for the social asset. Replaces the current cover.

aspect_ratio.description: Cover shape: "9:16" (vertical), "1:1" (square) or "16:9" (wide). The API defaults to "9:16".

channel_preset.description: Social format. Sets aspect ratio, length and copy style. Clip posts: ig_reels, ig_stories, ig_carousel (Instagram square video), tiktok, yt_shorts, fb_reels, yt_longform, fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post. Card posts: ig_post, ig_stories, fb_post, linkedin_post, threads_post. Omit to use the post's own channel. Example: "ig_reels".

drop_id.description: Drop (social post) ID from list_team_drops or create_drop.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds: 15, 30 or 60. Picks the clip variant. The API defaults to 30.

include_overlay_text.description: true (API default) puts the tagline on the cover; false makes a clean image with no text.

layout.description: Where the cover text sits: "lower_third", "center", "upper_third" or "yt_shorts_safe" (clear of YouTube Shorts buttons). Omit to pick from channel and shape.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: regenerate_drop_cover
title: Regenerate drop cover
